_comment: Exchange calendars per market and year. 'closed' lists the weekdays on which the exchange is closed all day; weekends are always closed, including make-up working days. 'early_close' maps a trading day that ends early to the local time continuous trading stops (Hong Kong: the morning session only, until 12:00; US: 13:00 New York time). 'source' names the official notice the year was copied from, when it was retrieved, and what it was cross-checked against. A year that is not listed is unknown: the calendar then falls back to weekdays only and says so (confidence 'weekday_only'). Unscheduled closures cannot be listed; Hong Kong keeps trading in typhoons and black rainstorms since 2024-09-23 (HKEX Severe Weather Trading). CN 2027 is not listed: on 2026-11-17 the State Council had published its 2027 holiday notice (2026-11-05) but neither SSE nor SZSE had published its 2027 closure notice.
